notes.title: Road map reveal.
notes.content: Hello everyone, thank you for your continued support! We've added a roadmap to serve as a guide to upcoming content to the game!

notes.title: Patch v1.03
notes.content:
-Added Indicators to show whether you have collected the goats of specific levels
-Fixed an issue where you would not be able to get "Visit Erin's Farm" Achievement

notes.title: August 23 Patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the audio would not loop.
